verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.sm: Ta e taui atu ia Mitiana ona o le fanauga a Isaraelu, mulimuli ane ona faatasiina atu ai lea o oe i lou nuu.

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mose i le nuu, ua faapea atu, Ia sauniuni nisi o outou i le taua e sii atu e i latou ia Mitiana, e faaoo atu le taui mai le Arn ia Mitiana.

verses.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.sm: la taitoaafe i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu tou te aauina atu ai i le tana.

verses.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.sm: Ona faʻi ‘au lea ai le manomano o Isaraelu e taitoaafe i itu aiga; e sefulu o afe ma afe e lua e ua sauni i le tana.

verses.en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.sm: Ua aauina atu i latou e Mose i le tana e taitoaafe i itu aiga; latou te o i le taua ma Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro le ositaulaga, sa ia te ia mea paia ma pu e ili.

verses.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.sm: e pei ona poloai mai o le ALNI ia Mose, ua fasiotia e i latou o tane uma lava.

verses.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.sm: Ua latou fasiotia foi tupu o Mitiana faatasi ma i latou na fasia, o Evi, ma Rekema, ma Suro, ma Huro, ma Repa, o tupu e toalima o Mitiana; o Palaamo foi le atalii o Peoro ua latou fasiotia i le pelu.

verses.en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.sm: Ua ave foi faatagataotaua e le fanauga a Isaraelu o fafine o Mitiana, atoa ma o latou tama iti; o a latou lafu povi uma foi, ma a latou lafu mamoe uma, atoa ma a latou oloa uma ua latou vetea.

verses.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.sm: Io O a latou aai uma foi na latou nonofo ai, atoa ma o latou ‘olo uma, ua latou susunuina i le afi.

verses.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.sm: Ua latou ave foi le vete uma ma mea uma na maua, o tagata atoa foi ma manu.

verses.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.sm: Ona latou au mai ai lea o faatinifuga, ma mea na maua, atoa ma vete ia Mose, ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga, ma le faapotopotoga o le fanauga a Isaraelu i le toagalauapi i le eleele laugatasi o Moapi e latalata ane i Ioritana, e fesagai ma Ieriko.

verses.en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o Mose, ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga, ma alii sili uma o le faapotopotoga, e faafetaiai ia te i latou i tua o le toagālauapi.

verses.en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.sm: Ona ita lea o Mose i e sa pule i ʻau o le taua, o e na ave i taitoaafe, ma e na ave i taitoaselau; o e ua o mai i le taua sa tau.

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu a Mose ia te i latou, Ua outou faaolaina ea o fafine uma?

verses.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.sm: Faauta, o i latou ia na ala ai ona solia e le fanauga a Isaraelu le afioga a le ALI i le mea a Peoro, 3! ona o le upu a Palaamo; ona tupu ai lea o le faamai i le faapotopotoga a le ALI.

verses.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.sm: O lenei ia outou fasiotia tama tane uma o i tama iti, ma ia owon fasiotia foi fafine uma ua tanea.

verses.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.sm: A o tama teine uma e lei tanea, ia outou faaolaina mo outou.

verses.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.sm: A o outou foi, tou te nonofo i tua o le toagalauapi i aso e fitu; ai se na na fasiotia se tasi, ai se na pai atu foi i se tagata oti, tou te faamamàina outou i le aso tolu ma le aso fitu; o outou atoa ma o outou tagata o taua.

verses.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.sm: Ia outou faamamāina foi ofu uma, ma mea uma ua faia i pa‘u, ma tea uma ua faia i fulufulu o ‘oti, atoa ma mea uma ua faia i laau.

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Eleasaro le ositaulaga i ‘au na o atu i le taua, O le sauniga lenei o le tulafono na poloai mai ai le ALII ia Mose,

verses.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.sm: Tau lava o le auro, ma le ario, o le ‘apa memea, o le uamea, o le “apa sinasina, ma le pulu,

verses.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.sm: o mea uma e le afaina i le au tou te tuu i le afi, ona mamá ai lea; a e ui lava i lea ia faamamáina pea i le vai mo e ua leaga; ao mea uma e leaga i le afi tou te tuu i le vai.

verses.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.sm: Tou te taia foi o outou ofu i le aso fitu, ona mamá ai lea o outou, mulimuli ane tou o mai i le toagálauapi.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.sm: la e faitau mai le atoatoa o mea na maua i le vete, o tagata atoa ma manu; O oe, ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga, ma matai sili o le faapotopotoga;

verses.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.sm: ma ia outou vaeluagalemuina o mea na maua mo i latou e na faia le taua, ma latou o atu e tau i le tana, atoa ma le faapotopotoga uma.

verses.en: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.sm: la outou vaea mai foi se taulaga i le ALII ai ‘au na oi le taua, ia taitasi ai le tailima o selau o mea, O tagata, ma povi, ma asini, atoa ma mamoe.

verses.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
verses.sm: O la latou vaega ia au mai ai le taulaga, ma avatu ia Eleasaro le ositaulaga e fai ma taulaga sii i le ALn.

verses.en: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
verses.sm: A o le vaegamea a le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia e au mai ai ia taitasi i le tailimagafulu o mea, o tagata, ma povi, ma asini, ma mamoe, o manu uma lava, ma avatu ai i sa Levi, o e ua tausi i le tausiga o le malumalu o le ALII.

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e Mose ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga, e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.sm: O mea na maua, o toe o vete na maua e ‘au o le taua, o mamoe e ono selau o afe ma afe e fitu sefulu ma afe e lima.

verses.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.sm: O povi e fitu sefulu o afe ma afe e lua.

verses.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.sm: O asini e ono sefulu o afe ma le afe e tasi.

verses.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.sm: O le atoa foi o tagata, o fafine ua le tanea, e tolu sefulu o afe ma afe e lua.

verses.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.sm: O le vaeluagalemu foi, o le vaegámea lea a e na o i le tana, o le tauaofai o mamoe e tolu selau o*afe ma afe e tolu sefulu ma afe e fitu ma le lima o selau.

verses.en: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.sm: O le taulaga foi i le Aw ai mamoe ia, c ono o selau ma le fitu o sefulu ma le lima.

verses.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.sm: O povi e tolu sefulu o afe ma afe e ono. O le taulaga foi ile ALII ai ia mea, c fitugafulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and one.
verses.sm: O asini e tolu sefulu o afe ma le lima o selau. O le taulaga foi i le ALII ai ia mea, e onogafulu ma le tasi.

verses.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.sm: O tagata e sefulu o afe ma afe e ono. O le taulaga foi i le ALII ai ia te i latou e toatolugafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua avatu e Mose le taulaga ia Eleasaro le ositaulaga, o le taulaga sii i le ALII, e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.sm: A o le vaegamea a le fanauga a Isaraelu na vaea e Mose ai ‘au na tau i le taua;

verses.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.sm: (o le vaegamea lenei a le faapotopotoga; o mamoe e tolu selau o afe ma afe e tolu sefulu ma afe e fitu ma le lima o selau;

verses.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.sm: o povi e tolu sefulu o afe ma afe e ono;

verses.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.sm: 0 asini e tolu sefulu o afe ma le lima o selau;

verses.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.sm: o tagata foi e sefulu o afe ma afe e ono;)

verses.en: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: ua ave e Mose ai le vaegamea a le fanauga a Isaraelu e taitasi i le liniagafulu o mea, o tagata atoa ma manu, ma na avatua i sa Levi, o e na tausi i le tausiga o le malumalu o le ALTI, e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALr ia Mose.

verses.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea ia Mose o alii na pule i afe na 6 i le taua, o e na ave i taitoaafe, ma e na ave i taitoaselau.

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai mai ia Mose, Ua uma ona faitau e au auauna le aofai o ‘au o le taua na ia te i matou; ua leai so matou e toatasi o le iloa;

verses.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
verses.sm: o le mea lea ua matou au mai ai le taulaga i le ALII, o mea na maua taitasi a tagata, o teuga auro, ma filifili auro, ma taulima, ma mama, ma mama o taliga, ma asoa auro, e fai a“ se togiola mo i matou i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.sm: SI Ona talia lea e Mose ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga le auro mai ia te i latou, o teuga uma ua faia.

verses.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.sm: O auro uma foi o le taulaga sii na avatu i le ALII e alii na ave i taitoaafe, ma alii na ave i taitoaselau, e sefulu o afe ma afe e ono ma le fitu o selau ma le limagafulu o sekeli ia.

verses.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.sm: O “au o le taua na latou taitoatasi ma fai lana vete,

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua talia e Mose ma Eleasaro le ositaulaga le auro i alii na ave i taitoaafe, ma e na ave i taitoaselau, ua la avatua i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga e fai ma faamanatuga mo le fanauga a Isaraelu i luma o le ALII.
